career_ladder.note: Postman, Mail Guard, and Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) in the Department of Posts (India Post) are central government civil employees under the Ministry of Communications. Personnel progress through the postal hierarchy via Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations (LDCE) and time-bound MACP (Modified Assured Career Progression) promotions.

exam_scheme.note: Selection is governed by the Directorate of Postal Services examination framework comprising Paper I (Postal Knowledge & General Awareness, competitive for merit), Paper II (Local Language, qualifying), and Paper III (Data Entry Skill Test, qualifying for Postman/Mail Guard).

financial_package.note: Postman and Mail Guard personnel receive pay under 7th CPC Matrix Level 3 (entry basic pay ₹21,700), while MTS receive Level 1 (entry basic pay ₹18,000). The package includes 58% Central DA constant as of 2025-07-01, HRA (up to 27% in X-class cities), transport allowance, and uniform allowances.
financial_package.pay_level: 7th CPC Level 3 (₹21,700 – ₹69,100) for Postman; Level 1 (₹18,000 – ₹56,900) for MTS

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 3 Postman: Basic Pay ₹21,700, 58% DA (₹12,586), HRA (9% to 27% = ₹1,953 to ₹5,859), Transport Allowance (₹1,350 to ₹3,600 + DA), less NPS (10% of Basic+DA = ₹3,429) and CGHS deductions.
